value_derivation.role: Penalize xy-axis base angular velocity using L2 squared kernel (Isaac Lab v2.3.1, reports/evidence/go2_reward_term_roles_20260917/isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py:83): -w * (omega_x^2 + omega_y^2) in the body frame. It charges roll/pitch rate, not tilt and not a fall.
value_derivation.walk_margin: G-A043 rewards -> candidate rewards: walk margin +0.0849 for the candidate (go2_reward_mechanism.spec_margin, zone WALK, about 5.5 times the stop zone's top +0.0155).
value_derivation.situations: spec_margin situations for the candidate rewards: climb +0.015, sway +0.276, push +0.115. The sheet's cells got directions wrong on this baseline before (G-A047, G-A048); they are recorded, not used as predictions.
value_derivation.rule: -0.08 is chosen because it is the strengthening value actually measured on a walking reference policy (G-A038 on G-A033); being the deployed start value and the lecture example is supporting only. It is not claimed to be the only possible value or an optimum, and no data says -0.08 beats -0.06 or -0.10 on G-A043.
value_derivation.not_claimed: No score gain is estimated. Why G-A043 starts to tilt and why it does not recover is not explained (principle step 2 unmet); the G-A056 diagnostic replay is the open work on that question. G-A038's rough gain came with a terrain-level difference at iteration 900 (G-A033 4.4937, G-A038 1.9499), so its mechanism is not separated.

preregistered.threshold_basis: Measured, not intended, and UNCHANGED from G-A050 (and G-A049, G-A048, G-A044, G-A043) on purpose for fact_rules_v1 - no adoption threshold moves after any result; the plan screening edition is g3_guard_margin_v1, preregistered before G-A050 (user decision G-D-G3-FIRST-20260927) and carried unchanged. tools/go2_eval_resolution.py (reports/runs/BASELINE_MARGIN.csv delta_resample_sd) gave per-scenario weighted-score standard deviations of G3 1.01823, G4 0.49816, G6 0.43098, G2 0.28229, G7 0.20179, G5 0.02802, G1 0.00000 (/70) and a total-difference sd of 1.26443/70. The share of time, before the first termination, in which the commanded-direction projected speed stays under 0.05 m/s for at least one continuous second, with the first 0.5 s and the terminal row excluded; null with a reason when the valid time is zero. The first timestamp at which the existing >=1 step climb rule fires, per robot, with non-arrivals recorded as null and censored=true. The mean over arrivals may not be reported as an improvement without the arrival rate beside it.

hypothesis.statement: On G-A043's rewards, ang_vel_xy_l2 -0.08 lowers rough side-step posture falls from G-A043's 24 to 12 or fewer (the improvement direction G-A038 showed on G-A033 appears on G-A043). The combined right turn and the four push directions are measured under this change for the first time and are classified, not predicted.

rough_lateral_posture_falls.basis: G-A043 fell 24 of 96 (8 / 11 / 5). 12 is half of 24, the same operational rule as G-A051 (half of the base); not a statistical or official criterion. 13-23 is INSUFFICIENT ('reduced, below target'). Condition C (case score and speed) is read by tools/go2_g_a055_readout.py, not here.

hypothesis.edge_rule: Avoiding falsification is not support. 13 to 23 rough side-step falls is INSUFFICIENT and is reported as 'reduced, below the target of 12', not as 'no improvement'. A fall reduction counts as an improvement only with condition C (tools/go2_g_a055_readout.py).
decisions: rough SUPPORTED with C and combined right turn TARGET_LEVEL: go to candidate review (videos, protection deltas, self-assessment); adoption follows section 3; no automatic long training.

rough SUPPORTED with C, right turn not at target level: report 'the rough improvement direction was observed on G-A043; the right-turn target was not met' with the actual counts; the right turn stays a separate cause question.
rough INSUFFICIENT or NOT_SUPPORTED: the value's hypothesis is not supported on G-A043; no automatic neighbouring value (-0.07, -0.09).
mixed results: no automatic neighbouring value; report per-case verdicts and choose separately.
missing data or unverified harvest: no performance conclusion.

stairs_10_ge2.basis: recorded, not judged: G-A043 94 of 96, G-A038 0.

combined_yaw_right_posture_falls.basis: recorded here; classified against G-A043 29 by tools/go2_g_a055_readout.py.

reward_base_comparison.verdicts: REVIEW_CANDIDATE (all four requirements; a quantitative review candidate, not final progress) / NOT_REVIEW_CANDIDATE (lists the failed ones) / INCONCLUSIVE (unverified harvest or missing data)

min_speed.basis: Condition C's speed floor: G-A043's lowest seed (0.1642 / 0.1664 / 0.1580 m/s). The candidate's three-seed mean is compared with G-A043's lowest seed, so it is an operational floor, not a like-for-like statistic. Meeting it does NOT show the policy did not slow down.

reward_base_comparison.not_judged: A043-relative losses on the protected cases have no preregistered limit in this reader; the first-priority cases are classified by tools/go2_g_a055_readout.py and the stairs are disclosed there. A person judges the rest at review; no limit is set after seeing results.

g_a055_case_readout.case_score: survival x tracking per case and seed, tools/go2_axis_bottleneck.case_row (stairs: min(tracking, completion); combined turns: min(xy, yaw); push: post-push tracking or upright recovery); the minimum over three seeds is compared.

why: Purpose: cut G-A043's first-priority losses (combined right turn 29 falls, rough side-step 24, push 10) while keeping its stairs lead (G5 1.62, 15 cm ge2 77). Not a promise of a higher score.
Support: the lecture's 'do not tilt the body' and the deployed 'strong: less wobble'; G-A038 (-0.08 on G-A033) cut rough side-step falls 59 -> 18.

Against: G-A038 slowed rough side-stepping and collapsed the 10 cm climb (96 of 96); G-A041 (-0.04) also collapsed it (93 of 96), so the stairs cost is not direction-specific. Why G-A043 starts to tilt is not explained; in some rough events a lateral-velocity change was observed before the tilt increase (reports/GO2_A043_TILT_ONSET_20260928.md).
Status: conditional preparation, execution not approved (Codex 2026-09-29). Not linked to G-A056.

ang_vel_xy_l2.role: Penalize xy-axis base angular velocity using L2 squared kernel. [isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py:83]
ang_vel_xy_l2.out_of_range_reason: Only -0.05 is a walking value in the base table: G-A038 (-0.08) and G-A041 (-0.04) measured partial rows. -0.08 is the one strengthening point measured on a walking reference; it is exploratory on G-A043, not an interpolation.

lin_vel_z_l2.role: Penalize z-axis base linear velocity using L2 squared kernel. [isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py:76]

inference.rule: fact-based inference chain (2026-09-17 user instruction; MASTER section 5, AGENTS 4-9); a point-gain estimate is not required
inference.role: Isaac Lab v2.3.1 ang_vel_xy_l2 (reports/evidence/go2_reward_term_roles_20260917/isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py:83) pays -w * (omega_x^2 + omega_y^2) of the body-frame angular velocity. It charges roll/pitch rate, not tilt and not a fall; the link to rollovers is G-A038's observation, not the formula.

rows.reads: the run the support comes from: G-A038 trained ang_vel_xy_l2 -0.08 on G-A033's other weights, measured with the same instrument (posture_gate_v2) and walked (POLICY_LOCOMOTES).
G-A038 (-0.08 on G-A033) rough side-step falls per seed 4 / 8 / 6 = 18 against G-A033's 20 / 20 / 19 = 59.
the G-A033 counterpart of the row above.
the reward base: G-A043 rough side-step falls 8 / 11 / 5 = 24 of 96, the count this change targets.

contradicting.reads: the same G-A038 run collapsed the 10 cm climb: 32 posture falls of 32 at every seed, survival 0.
the relaxing direction also collapsed the 10 cm climb (30 / 32 / 31), so the stairs cost is not read as a direction effect of this term.
and slowed rough side-stepping: 0.162 / 0.159 / 0.149 m/s against G-A033's 0.200 / 0.195 / 0.190.

terrain level at iteration 900 was G-A033 4.4937 against G-A038 1.9499 (reports/GO2_G_A038_READOUT.md), the reward change may itself have caused that difference, so the direct mechanism of both G-A038 results is not separated.

in the second before tilt onset G-A043's falling robots side-step at 0.270 m/s against 0.138 for survivors at the same time, with an uncommanded yaw of 0.127; in some events the lateral-velocity change came before the tilt increase. This term charges roll/pitch rate; how it acts on that lateral-velocity change is not known.

inference.singularity: One strengthening point on another reward base cut rough side-step falls to a third while collapsing the 10 cm climb, with a terrain-level difference at iteration 900 (G-A033 4.4937, G-A038 1.9499); the relaxing direction also collapsed the climb. On G-A043 the combined right turn loses 29 of 96 and was never measured under this change.

walk.basis: spec_margin for the candidate rewards stays in the WALK zone (base_data.walk_margin). No walking change is claimed.

climb.basis: G-A038 collapsed the 10 cm climb at this value on G-A033, with a terrain-level difference; G-A041 collapsed it in the other direction. Not predicted.

sway.basis: the hypothesis: rough side-step falls below G-A043's 24 (supported at 12 or fewer with condition C). Exploratory, from G-A038 only.

push.basis: G-A043 lost 10 robots over four directions; judged per direction, no direction claimed.

inference.falsified_if: Hypothesis (tools/go2_dial_hypothesis.py): not supported if rough side-step posture falls are 24 or more of 96; 13-23 is INSUFFICIENT ('reduced, below target'). Case readout (tools/go2_g_a055_readout.py) classifies the right turn and push without a hypothesis.
inference.seed_limit: Every training run used seed 42 and no seed replicate exists, so a result supports or refutes the exploratory hypothesis at this value on this path; it does not generalize.
inference.status_reason: INFORMATION_RUN: the only prior is G-A038 on another reward base with its own cost and a terrain-level difference; the right turn, which carries G-A043's largest loss, was never measured under this change.
inference.counterevidence_response: The adverse rows set the readout, not the value: the stairs are second-priority protection with G-A033 limits unchanged and A043-relative losses disclosed; the slower side-stepping becomes condition C; the unexplained lateral-velocity change keeps the run conditional on the G-A056 readout.

reward_base.name: G-A043
reward_base.why: Codex selected G-A043's reward setting as the base because it holds the highest stairs score of the stored arms (G5 1.62) and asked for one change on it aimed at its first-priority losses. G-A043's own adoption failed; it is a reward base, not an adoption baseline.
